quotes.add.description: Saves a new quote. It gets the next number. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action. Fails when the text is empty.

parameters.text: The quote, like "I never miss a jump."
parameters.user: Optional. Who said it, like "CoolStreamer". Leave it out for the user of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. That person's user id. Leave it out for the id of the trigger's user.
parameters.platform: Optional. The platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.game: Optional. The game, like "Celeste". Leave it out for the game Cuebot last saw you stream.

quotes.add.returns: The new quote, with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt.

parameters.id: The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too).

quotes.delete.returns: true when it existed, otherwise false.

quotes.edit.description: Changes a quote. Only what you pass is changed; the rest stays.

parameters.id: The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too).
parameters.user: Optional. The new name of who said it.

quotes.edit.returns: The changed quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when there is no such quote.

quotes.get.description: Gets one quote by its number.

parameters.id: The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too).

quotes.get.returns: An object with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt. null when there is no such quote.

quotes.random.description: Picks a random quote. Can pick only among quotes that contain a word, and can fire the Quote shown trigger.

parameters.search: Optional. Only quotes whose text, user or game contains this, like "jump". A number also matches that quote id.
parameters.show: Optional. true also runs your Quote shown trigger with the picked quote. Leave it out for false.

quotes.random.returns: The quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when none match.

quotes.search.description: Finds quotes whose text, user or game contains a word. Upper or lower case does not matter.

parameters.query: What to look for, like "jump". Leave it empty for every quote.

quotes.search.returns: A list of quotes, each with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt.

quotes.show.description: Runs your Quote shown trigger for a quote, so an overlay or action can display it.

parameters.id: The quote number, like 12 ("#12" works too).

quotes.show.returns: The quote with id, text, user, userId, platform, game and createdAt, or null when there is no such quote.
